issues.problem: Negative 'ex' values (ありません, ありませんでした, もうありません) make は at least as natural as が in negative existentials (この町に銀行はありません), but the slot accepted only が, so a learner answering は would be marked wrong.
issues.action: Replaced the negative values with positive ones where が is clearly the best answer: もうあります (There is already), 昔ありました (There used to be), ちゃんとあります (There really is). Kept あります, ありました, まだあります. Rewrote 'why' so it no longer claims negatives too, and set lv to 4 because of 昔. Still 378 combinations.

issues.problem: よくできます was translated 'speaks excellent', which overstates よく (well).
issues.action: Changed the English to 'speaks good' (e.g. 'My father speaks good Korean').
